item.title: SMC Emeritus Gallery to Open Annual Student Photography Exhibition March 5
item.description: Santa Monica College Emeritus Gallery opens its 2026 Annual Student Photography Exhibition March 5-April 24, featuring works by 32 students downtown.

item.title: Nonprofit to Host Fundraiser for Youth Mental Health Programs
item.description: The Social & Emotional Wellness Initiative hosts Spring Into Wellness fundraiser March 14 at Annenberg Community Beach House in Santa Monica.

item.title: Church in Ocean Park responds to vandalism with renewed sense of community
item.description: Church in Ocean Park was vandalized with homophobic graffiti Friday, prompting community support and fundraising for recovery efforts.

item.title: LA County Sues Roblox Over Child Safety Failures
item.description: Los Angeles County filed the first California government lawsuit against Roblox for child endangerment, alleging the gaming platform failed to protect kids from predators and explicit content.

item.title: Caltrans to Close Topanga Canyon Boulevard Overnight Saturday for Pavement Restoration
item.description: Caltrans will close Topanga Canyon Boulevard between PCH and Grand View Drive from 10 p.m. Saturday to 10 a.m. Sunday for pavement restoration.

item.title: Santa Monica College Planetarium Offers Spring Sky Shows in March
item.description: Santa Monica College Planetarium offers spring sky shows throughout March 2024 with live presentations on Friday evenings and Sunday afternoons. Tickets $7-$10.

item.title: World Premiere of 'The Best Boarding House in Delaware' Opens March 5 at Electric Lodge Theater
item.description: Emmy winner Leigh Taylor-Young stars in world premiere of 'The Best Boarding House in Delaware' at Electric Lodge Theater Venice March 5-29, 2025.
